allow_instructions: Read-only repository inspection, git status/diff/log, npm test, npm run check, npm run build:extension, and WebQA health checks are normal development actions for this repository.
block_instructions: Require review before browser automation or scans of external sites until the requested test origin is clear and intentional.
Require review before git push, force push, reset --hard, git clean, destructive checkout/restore, or any command that could discard work.
Require review before SSH, production deployment, Docker restart/up/down on remote systems, or any production write operation.
Require review before modifying, printing, copying, or transmitting .env files, credentials, API keys, browser authentication tokens, or other secrets.
Require review before deleting files outside generated build output or qa-runs.
